instruction.name: vpickve2gr.du
instruction.description: Pick the 64-bit element at lane `idx` from `a`, zero-extend it to the GPR width, and store it in `dst`.

experiments.name: round trip through the reverse move

latencies.notes: Slope method (--unroll 100000, --unroll2 200000), median of three runs; 1 cycles of flag-helper latency subtracted where the chain closes through x86mtflag/x86mfflag. Measured on 2026-11-17 on LA464, core 0.

throughput.name: 8 independent lanes
